_doc: During-war component config (spec v0.4). One entry per initiator->territory pair; theater defaults apply unless a pair sets 'overrides'. All values provisional until Phase 5.

middle_east_war._notes: mu = cessation of fighting (accepted offer). h = re-entry; theory: SSPE onset hazard, engine value is a lower bound (engine prices interstate war A); Phase 5 wires it. announcement_lr is used from v2b on: weak because a non-self-enforcing deal is announced without cessation (commitment problem, Powell 2006).

Israel->Lebanon._seed_source: Israeli strike campaign in Lebanon from Mar 2, 2026. With primary rates the seed is forgotten long before the first resolution (Sep).

Saudi Arabia->Yemen._combatants_note: Default unless Adi objects (Oct 19). Only feeds the ceasefire classifier; qualifying strikes are any on Yemeni land territory.
Saudi Arabia->Yemen._seed_source: Saudi air campaign after the Houthi maritime embargo (Jul 20). dyad_configs onset 2026-07-25 is the data-start date, not the onset.
Saudi Arabia->Yemen._day_tz_note: Rules text: 'on the specified date, Yemen Standard Time' (UTC+3).
